title: Crashes as deliberate seeding (gorilla in the cage)

tellings.quote: some of these, you know, crashes were and it wasn't really a mission failure, if you will. It was, you know, maybe some seeding.

plain: Some crashes of unknown craft may not have been accidents at all, but a kind of deliberate seeding, like dropping an object into a gorilla's cage to see what it does. David Grusch, a former Air Force intelligence officer, passes on this idea from someone he calls Luis. If true, it would mean whoever made the craft let humans find them on purpose.
